Config.Title: D20 Loot Tracker
Config.NotConnected: This world is not connected to a D20 Loot Tracker campaign.
Config.DisconnectConfirm: Stop syncing this world? D20 Loot Tracker revokes this connection. Items already in Foundry and in D20 stay as they are.
Config.OtherClient: Sync runs in the browser that connected this world, while it is open. To sync from this browser instead, connect here.
Config.OtherClientNamed: Sync runs in the browser where {name} connected this world, while it is open. To sync from this browser instead, connect here.
Config.UnsupportedSystem: This game system is not supported. D20 Loot Tracker syncs Pathfinder 1e, Pathfinder 2e and D&D 5e worlds.
Config.CharactersHint: Pick the Foundry actor that holds each D20 character's items and coins. Characters without an actor do not sync.
Config.NoPlayers: The campaign has no characters yet, or the list has not loaded. Use Sync now to load it.
Config.PartyHint: The Party inventory and the Party Fund.
Config.LootHint: Loot dropped into this actor lands in D20 as unprocessed loot. Once it is claimed in D20, it moves to that character's sheet.
Config.FirstLinkHint: Which side to keep the first time this actor syncs
Config.FirstLinkExplain: The first sync of a newly linked actor pairs items by name. Keep both: paired items take D20's values, and items only one side has are added to the other; coins stay as D20 has them, unless D20 has none, in which case the actor's coins go to D20. D20 wins: the actor's inventory and coins become what D20 holds, and items D20 does not have are removed from the actor. Foundry wins: D20 takes the actor's inventory and coins, and D20 items the actor does not have are marked Discarded. After the first sync, the latest change on either side wins.
Config.ConfirmTitle: Replace items on the first sync?
Config.ConfirmD20: D20 wins removes the items D20 does not have from {names}.
Config.ConfirmFoundry: Foundry wins marks as Discarded the D20 items missing from {names}.
Config.ConfirmContinue: Save the links and run the first sync?
